title: Kan fibrations are equivalences exactly when their fibers are contractible
statement: Use spaces, horns, weak homotopy equivalences and weak contractibility as in [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. A Kan fibration is a simplicial map with the right lifting property against every horn inclusion $\Lambda_i^n\hookrightarrow\Delta^n$ with $n\geq1$ and $0\leq i\leq n$ (outer horns included). Let $p:E\to Q$ be a Kan fibration between small Kan complexes. Then $p$ is a weak homotopy equivalence if and only if every strict fiber $\{q\}\times_Q E$ over a vertex $q\in Q$ is weakly contractible.
